besluite.fout: 'hulle melk' right after 'Wie die beeste opgepas het' can be read as the caretakers' own milk rather than the cattle's.
besluite.rede: 'die melk' points unambiguously to the lent cattle's milk, matches 'die kalwers' later in the sentence, and keeps the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'kon van hulle aan so 'n nuweling ... leen' lets 'van hulle ... leen' read on first pass as 'borrow from them', so the reader stumbles over who lends to whom.
besluite.rede: 'van sy beeste' keeps the same lender, receiver and partitive sense while removing the borrow-from misreading; no fact is added.
